guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: adservice is the only service whose error rate rises (0 -> 0.0139, z=+20) and it logs 3482 NullPointerExceptions in AdService, while frontend logs 1763 'failed to retrieve ads'. The only resource signal on adservice is CPU +76% (z=+1.96), which is weak, and the NPE looks like a code or data bug, so the cpu fault type is a best guess among the allowed types.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll back the adservice pod and inspect the AdService code path that passes a null collection to ArrayList.addAll; also check CPU limits on adservice. Non-destructive and reversible.
